notes.title: Caldera v1.02 Patch
notes.content:
2/18/2024
Caldera v1.02

Fixed bug where Safety Deposit box was not saving.
Fixed bug with Saving/Loading Tents, Campfires, and Camping Stools.
Fixed bug where the Tooltip was preventing players from interacting with their inventory.
Fixed bug where Silver Specimens were not selling to the bank.
